items.summary: SpaceX is offering employees a 20% pay premium for six-week assignments in Memphis, Tennessee, and Southaven, Mississippi, to speed up construction of its Colossus AI data centres.&nbsp;

items.title: Premji Invest, Norwest and Lok Capital back Vegafin’s majority stake in Bizloan with up to  ₹1,000 crore in commitment
items.summary: The capital will fund Vegafin's acquisition of a majority stake in Gurugram-based Bizloan and fuel the scale-up of its own AI-led, hybrid MSME lending platform.

items.title: PHP2Shell vulnerability: ‘Most significant security issues…,’ How Google, OpenAI and Amazon respond to the cyber threat
items.summary: Critical PHP vulnerabilities known as PHP2Shell could let attackers remotely execute code and access sensitive data. Amazon detected exploitation attempts before public disclosure, while Google and OpenAI researchers helped identify and investigate the flaws.&nbsp;

items.title: Micron reaches deal with Taiwan union amid bonus dispute; October 22 strike still looms
items.summary: Micron reaches a labour agreement with its Taichung union in Taiwan as a separate Taoyuan union prepares for an October 22 strike over bonuses.

items.title: Meta’s share deal with Zuckerberg aims to cover potential multibillion-dollar wealth tax bill: How it works
items.summary: Meta has agreed to keep CEO Mark Zuckerberg in California for eight years as the state considers a proposed one-time 5% tax on billionaires. A new class of nonvoting shares will let him raise cash while preserving his voting control and support Meta’s AI investment plans.

items.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion penalty: What's the data privacy case? Will it impact value of Zuckerberg's company?
items.summary: A New Mexico court has ordered Meta to pay $25 billion after a jury found it misled consumers about data privacy. The company plans to appeal the ruling, which stems from allegations linked to the Cambridge Analytica scandal and Facebook users' personal data.

items.title: L&T wins large orders worth  ₹2,500-5,000 crore for Delhi Secretariat buildings, Andhra Pradesh office towers
items.summary: L&amp;T has secured large construction orders worth  ₹2,500-5,000 crore for two Central Secretariat buildings in New Delhi and two 47-storey office towers in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh. The projects are scheduled for completion within 24 and 30 months.

items.title: KKR, OTPP-backed Vertis eyes IPO filing by January, public listing by April 2027
items.summary: KKR- and OTPP-backed Vertis Infrastructure Trust plans to file a draft offer document by December and list publicly by April-May 2027, with the sponsors selling a combined 13-14% stake (over  ₹2,000 crore) via an offer for sale.

items.title: India’s luxury watch boom is ticking. Franck Muller wants a bigger share
items.summary: India is emerging as a bright spot for Swiss watchmakers amid uneven global demand. Franck Muller sees the market closing the gap with Singapore and the UAE, and is exploring airport retail, celebrity partnerships and branded residences, though demand for watches above  ₹50 lakh remains limited.

items.title: Indian Oil announces Subrat Kar's departure after 38 years: Here's a look at his career, achievements and more
items.summary: Indian Oil announced Subrat Kar’s departure after 38 years. Its Executive Director (Planning and Economic Studies) held leadership roles in retail sales, international business and strategy, including heading IOC Middle East.

items.title: How Bajaj Consumer Care is defying an FMCG slowdown
items.summary: Low-entry price points, a revamped direct distribution setup, and portfolio diversification are driving over 25% revenue growth for the hair oil maker even as sector peers grapple with muted volumes.

items.title: Flipkart-owned fashion e-commerce giant Myntra’s FY26 financials: How falling logistics income dragged revenue down
items.summary: Myntra’s operating revenue declined in FY26 as logistics revenue fell 53.2% to  ₹1,119.2 crore, outweighing modest marketplace growth and a 35.2% rise in advertising income.&nbsp;

items.title: Flipkart tests ‘Eat-in by Minutes’ in Bengaluru to challenge Zomato, Swiggy in food delivery market
items.summary: Flipkart's planned entry comes at a time when the country's food services industry is witnessing strong growth.

items.title: FSSAI issues notices to Nestlé India, Zydus Wellness over product claims
items.summary: FSSAI has issued notices to Nestlé India over claims on Lactogen Pro 1 and Nan Excella Pro Stage 1, seeking scientific evidence. Zydus Wellness also received a notice over Complan, but said its claims are factual and backed by science.

items.title: Ex-Brevan Howard Trader Sued by Quant Who Joined His New Fund
items.summary: Ex-Brevan Howard Asset Management portfolio manager Robert Sicari was accused of withholding millions of dollars in promised trading profits from a former colleague who joined his new fund.

items.title: Eternal revises Blinkit store target as Q2 net profit rises 92%
items.summary: Blinkit’s quick-commerce margins improved for a sixth straight quarter, while Zomato sustained food-delivery growth through customer acquisition investments.

items.title: Essar Ports wins  ₹2,276 crore Tuna Tekra terminal project in Gujarat
items.summary: The project will be developed under a 30-year build-operate-transfer (BOT) concession through the public-private partnership (PPP) route

items.title: DeepSeek raises $15 billion to challenge Anthropic, OpenAI and other US AI labs
items.summary: The Chinese AI pioneer DeepSeek has raised about 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) in its latest fundraising round, one of the country’s largest ever and a sign of the startup’s ambitions to compete globally with the likes of Anthropic PBC and OpenAI.

items.title: Corporate VCs bullish on India but rush is yet to start: TDK Ventures founder Nicolas Sauvage
items.summary: Semiconductors, AI infrastructure and robotics are the main areas of interest in India, alongside energy transition and digital transformation.

items.title: Cognizant is putting 18,000 engineers behind Google Gemini: What they will build and why
items.summary: Cognizant and Google Cloud are assigning more than 18,000 employees to develop AI agents for clients, targeting software modernisation, developer tools, business-process automation and cybersecurity.&nbsp;

items.title: Carlsberg prepares India business IPO worth up to $700 million, eyes December launch
items.summary: Carlsberg A/S is preparing to publicly file documents for an initial public offering of its India business, which could raise as much as $700 million, as early as this week, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: BioWare games shutdown: What's next for Baldur’s Gate, Neverwinter Nights, Star Wars, Dragon Age, Mass Effect, Anthem?
items.summary: According to an official BioWare blog post, the fate of Dragon Age, Mass Effect and its other beloved intellectual properties remains a complex web of cancellations, shifting priorities, and third-party licensing.

items.title: BioWare games shutdown: No end to job cuts? What led to 400 layoffs at Electronic Arts? What official blog confirmed
items.summary: According to Bloomberg, BioWare's latest title, Dragon Age: The Veilguard, fell short of sales expectations, which had already prompted EA to impose steep cuts at the developer last year.

items.title: Anthropic opens  ₹3.26 crore job for human writers; experts say it's a ‘premium on judgment’
items.summary: Anthropic wants a candidate with at least eight years of experience who can quickly digest technical concepts, sharpen executive thinking, and maintain composure during breaking news.

items.title: Ambani family hosts Marco Rubio and Sergio Gor at Jamnagar refinery; Reliance, US explore energy partnership
items.summary: Reliance Industries Chairman Mukesh Ambani and Executive Director Anant Ambani hosted US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Ambassador Sergio Gor in Jamnagar. Here's what they discussed during the visit.

items.title: Adani Green races ahead, but a sluggish grid isn't helping
items.summary: Delays in grid capacity expansion meant that grid availability for Adani Green was less than 80% during the quarter and triggering production curtailment to keep the grid balanced.

items.title: 43 million ‘willful violations’: Here’s why Meta has been ordered to pay $25 billion in privacy case
items.summary: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion for misleading residents about privacy and the spread of harmful content. The ruling followed a jury finding more than 43 million violations of state law.&nbsp;

items.title: $30 million! Who is Zach Yadegari? Meet teenage founder - Know how he turned AI calorie tracking into a massive business
items.summary: American entrepreneur Zach Yadegari co-founded Cal AI, a calorie-tracking app that reportedly generated more than $30 million in annual revenue before its acquisition by MyFitnessPal. Now, the 19-year-old founder is building Persona, an AI assistant startup that has raised $10 million.
